The interrogative למה (for what/why) is jointly recast as What needeth. Although מה suggests What, needeth expresses the necessity questioned by the whole construction rather than an independently recoverable meaning of the lamed alone, so that finer split is not preferred under rule 2. The demonstrative זה independently takes it and is not absorbed into this unit. The opening lamed is the source display anchor and needeth the English lexical anchor.
